steps.text: A simple torch is a complete electric circuit you can hold. Let's look at its parts.
Tap each component to explore it — the cells, the bulb, the switch, and the reflector.
Now toggle the switch on. It closes the circuit so current flows from the cells to the bulb, and the bulb lights up.
Cells provide the power, wires and the metal casing carry the current, the switch controls it, and the bulb turns it into light. A torch is a circuit in your hand.

coach.mission: Explore the parts of a torch and light the bulb.
whenStuck: Tap each component, then toggle the switch on.
The bulb lights only when the switch closes the circuit.
whenWrong: The bulb lights only when the switch is ON and the circuit is complete.
Cells power it, the switch controls it, the bulb gives light.
whenCorrect: Right — closing the switch lit the bulb.
Good — you found how each part works together.
coach.done: You've explored the torch as a circuit. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
